limits.memory: Chromium JavaScript heap when exposed, worker cache counters, renderer-retained byte estimates, and summed benchmark Chromium process RSS. RSS may double-count shared pages and excludes some GPU/canvas allocations; host MemAvailable is also recorded.
limits.rendering: Pi /usr/bin/chromium in Playwright headless mode, without forced SwiftShader arguments. Backend is recorded from the running app.

stopReason: Stopped after the first wall-only case because repeated successful after=0 page requests did not advance replay cursor or produce data/visible wall segments; do not interpret as staging performance acceptance.
